service.name: browser-automation-studio
service.description: Visual browser automation studio with AI-powered workflow builder and real-time debugging

steps.name: create-data-dirs
steps.description: Create data directories for workflow storage

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && go mod download && go build -o browser-automation-studio-api .

steps.name: build-cli
steps.description: Build the scenario-local CLI used by runtime contract validation

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: cd ui && if [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm install --ignore-workspace; else echo 'No package.json found, skipping pnpm install'; fi

steps.name: install-playwright-driver-deps
steps.description: Install Playwright driver dependencies and refresh generated local proto types

develop.description: Start browser automation studio with production UI bundle

steps.name: start-playwright-driver
steps.run: echo 'ℹ️  Playwright driver lifecycle managed by API sidecar supervisor'
steps.description: Skipped - API manages playwright driver lifecycle via sidecar supervisor. Set BAS_SIDECAR_ENABLED=false or PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_URL to use external driver.

steps.name: start-api
steps.run: export REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=7200000 SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=7200000 BAS_DRIVER_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_MS=7200000 BAS_EXECUTION_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=7200000; if [ -z "${PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_URL:-}" ]; then export PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_PORT}"; fi; if lpbs_api_port="$(vrooli scenario port landing-page-business-suite API_PORT 2>/dev/null)"; then export BAS_ENTITLEMENT_SERVICE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${lpbs_api_port}"; fi; cd api && ./browser-automation-studio-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

steps.name: start-ui
steps.description: Start Express server with built React app

stop.description: Stop all browser automation studio services

steps.name: stop-playwright-driver
steps.description: Stop scenario-managed Playwright driver if running

minio.description: Screenshot and artifact storage with S3-compatible API

ollama.description: AI workflow generation and debugging assistance

experience-manager.degraded_behavior: Readiness-profile resolution is unavailable while experience-manager is stopped; capture and execution APIs continue with their bounded default readiness behavior.

landing-page-business-suite.description: LPBS is the authoritative monetization and subscription provider
landing-page-business-suite.runtime_only_rationale: BAS reaches LPBS through its configured entitlement HTTP boundary and the control-plane-discovered local port; no Go package import is expected or desirable across scenario modules.
landing-page-business-suite.degraded_behavior: LPBS-backed Class-A entitlement and shared-session operations report unavailable while the authority is stopped; local Class-B work remains usable under a still-valid cached lease.

hostTools.name: ffmpeg
hostTools.reason: Render replay exports and media conversions for browser automation playback artifacts
hostTools.notes: Replay export features degrade when ffmpeg is unavailable

tier-1-local.notes: Runs today via Tier 1 local stack. Access is through app-monitor + Cloudflare tunnel. Persistent storage is local SQLite via api-core/storage.

secrets.notes: Prompt desktop users for their own API key when using remote LLMs

artifacts.notes: Standard Tier 1 exposure via Cloudflare Zero Trust

adaptations.impact: Ship the built driver and its Node dependencies as an Electron bundle asset; the API supervises it locally
adaptations.notes: Implemented by bundle/bundle.json and the API sidecar supervisor

adaptations.impact: Store artifacts in user data folder
adaptations.notes: Implemented by BAS_SCREENSHOT_STORAGE=local in the desktop bundle

tier-2-desktop.notes: Desktop ships the API, UI, CLI, supervised Playwright driver, and SQLite-backed local artifact storage; no MinIO or remote API is required for the bundled runtime.

artifacts.notes: Bundle proof stages the BAS API, UI, CLI, Playwright driver dist, and node_modules; monetized Class A calls remain LPBS-authorized.

tier-4-saas.notes: Viable once deployment-manager can provision Playwright driver pools and managed storage

tier-5-enterprise.notes: Follows SaaS path but with hardened secrets + monitoring

swappable_with.notes: Compiled runner bundled directly into desktop/mobile builds
